module.title: Passive tracers and ocean biogeochemistry
module.expensive_path: Advection-diffusion of many passive tracers (ptracers_integrate.F, one multidimensional advection pass per tracer per step) and the pointwise biogeochemical source terms (dic_biotic_forcing.F, bling_bio.F, carbon chemistry iteration in dic_carbon_chem.F / bling_carbonate_chem.F) evaluated over every wet cell.
module.rationale: Tracer transport plus source terms is embarrassingly parallel over cells and tracers and is the classic offline-acceleration target; it is validated by its own decks.
excluded: gmredi and cd_code enabled in these decks belong to other modules
hazards: Carbon chemistry uses iterative pH solves whose convergence depth sets the round-off floor
offline decks read pre-computed flow fields from the repository (small binaries)

approval.human_ref: looks rather nice, lets go? (2026-09-02, all six modules approved; package mitgcm-seaice first)
